name: std::fgetwc
intro: Reads the next wide character from the given input stream. getwc() may be implemented as a macro and may evaluate stream more than once.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
stream

 -

 to read the wide character from

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The next wide character from the stream or WEOF if an error has occurred or the end of file has been reached. If an encoding error occurred, errno is set to EILSEQ.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
